description: SMS, WhatsApp, e-mail and sign-in code settings for Hostel360 messaging.

fields.label: SMS Gateway
fields.description: Transactional SMS through a DLT-registered gateway. Every SMS template must be registered on the DLT portal with the same wording.

fields.label: API URL
fields.description: MSG91: leave blank to use https://control.msg91.com/api/v5/flow. Generic HTTP: the vendor's HTTPS send endpoint.

fields.label: Auth Key
fields.description: MSG91 auth key or the vendor's API key. Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Sender ID (DLT Header)
fields.description: Header approved on the DLT portal, usually six letters (for example ACGCET).

fields.label: Operations Alert Template ID
fields.description: MSG91 Flow template used for HyFib operations alerts. Variables sent: subject, message and VAR1 to VAR4 (30 characters each).

fields.label: Generic HTTP Provider
fields.description: For DLT vendors other than MSG91. The rendered message text, sender ID, DLT template ID and entity ID are sent as the parameters named below.

fields.label: Auth Header Name
fields.description: Header that carries the API key, for example Authorization or apikey. Leave blank to send the key as a parameter.

fields.label: Success Keyword
fields.description: Optional text that must appear in the response for the message to count as sent.

fields.label: Unicode Parameter
fields.description: Parameter that marks a Unicode (for example Tamil) message, if your gateway needs one. Leave blank if it detects Unicode itself.

fields.label: Unicode Parameter Value
fields.description: Value sent in the Unicode parameter, only with messages that contain Unicode characters.

fields.label: Additional Parameters
fields.description: Fixed parameters sent with every request, as a JSON object. Example: {"route": "transactional"}

fields.label: WhatsApp Business (Meta Cloud API)
fields.description: Business-initiated messages use templates approved in WhatsApp Manager. Template names and parameters are set on each Message Template.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.description: Permanent system-user token with whatsapp_business_messaging permission. Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Operations Alert Template Name
fields.description: Utility template with one body parameter, used for HyFib operations alerts.

fields.label: Enable Email
fields.description: Messages are queued through the default outgoing Email Account. Placeholder addresses ending in .invalid are never e-mailed.

fields.label: One-Time Passwords
fields.description: Students and parents sign in to the portal with their registered mobile number and a one-time code sent to that number or, if allowed below, to their registered e-mail address.

fields.label: Send Codes By
fields.description: Codes sent to the registered mobile number.

fields.label: Allow E-mail Sign-in Codes
fields.description: Students and parents may choose to get the code by e-mail instead. They still sign in with their mobile number; the code goes to the e-mail address the hostel office has on their student or guardian record (never to a portal placeholder address), straight through the default outgoing Email Account, which must send by SMTP. Needs Enable Email on the Email tab.

fields.label: Code Length
fields.description: Between 4 and 8 digits.

fields.label: Codes per IP Address per Hour
Trusted Networks
fields.description: One IP address or CIDR range per line, for example the campus Wi-Fi gateway. These networks are exempt from the per-IP code limit and get a far higher sign-in flood ceiling (100,000 requests an hour instead of 3,000); per-number limits still apply.

fields.label: Test Mode
fields.description: Write messages to the Message Log without sending them. Use while templates are being approved.

fields.label: Prefer WhatsApp over SMS
fields.description: When an event has both SMS and WhatsApp templates, send WhatsApp first and fall back to SMS only if WhatsApp fails.

fields.label: Alert After Consecutive Failures
fields.description: Raise a HyFib operations alert when a provider fails this many times in a row.

name: Messaging Settings
